Sacramento Kings — injuries
Sabonis (knee) is questionable to play Tuesday's game against the Magic.
Sabonis missed Sunday's 114-108 loss to the Heat with left knee soreness, making it his first absence of the season through 10 games. Dylan Cardwell earned the start with Sabonis sidelined, so if the latter is forced to miss a second straight contest, the former would be the top candidate to start once again.
